learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge of physical functions concerning air conditioning systems, with particular reference to the typical aspects of thermodynamics and fluid dynamics, beyond the principles of design needed for the implementation of the related matters.

To be able to establish the best project solution by the necessity of users in terms of comfort and money save; to be able to design or to select all components necessary to the functioning of the air conditioning plants.
To be able to detect and interpret the data required for the implementation of a project of a conditioning system.
To be able to work in a team of designers, to improve own inter-relational capacities and to amend the efficiency and efficiency of the communicative capacities in providing a project idea.
Develop the leading competences for inserting next studies in the field of the energy, with a particular reference to the design and to the management of the air conditioning plants.

assessment_methods.method: Project paper developed as a team

assessment_rules: The assessment will be based on a project paper (70%) and an oral exam (30%). The project paper is evaluated out of 30 points (Project Idea 0-5, Design Methods 0-15, Critical Sense 0-5, Reports and Graphic Tables 0-5). A minimum of 20 points on the project is required to qualify for the oral exam. The oral exam consists of two theoretical questions and is evaluated out of 17 points (Correctness of Answer 1-13, Method and Language 0-4). A minimum of 14 points on the oral exam is required.
